{{Infobox auto}}

'''Mead''' is the preservation of [[Honey|honey]]. It heals {{Value|Mead|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} for {{Value|Mead|duration|effect=Speed}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/mead.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, a brown mushroom, sugar and sweet berries, an apple or glow berries. Picking up a honey bottle unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Drinking mead takes {{Value|Mead|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Mead|heals}} and gives Speed {{Value|Mead|level|effect=Speed}} (+20% speed) for {{Value|Mead|duration|effect=Speed|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
